metric_detail: PECOS adopts 2021 NPPES state (median 3 yr, IQR 2-4 yr)
NPPES adopts 2021 PECOS state (median 2 yr, IQR 1-3 yr)

Of 892 identifiers where NPPES and PECOS disagreed in 2021, 145 (16.3%) PECOS adopted NPPES's 2021 value, after a median of 3.0 years (IQR 2.0-4.0; mean 2.7 years, 95% CI 2.5-2.9 years). Of 892 identifiers where NPPES and PECOS disagreed in 2021, 184 (20.6%) NPPES reverted to PECOS's 2021 value, after a median of 2.0 years (IQR 1.0-3.0; mean 2.4 years, 95% CI 2.2-2.6 years).
